dialogues.jp:
４時限目終了の鐘が鳴る。学生にとって一日で
最も祝福された時間、昼休みの始まりだ。
dialogues.en:
The bell rang, signifiying the end of 4th period. The time
of blessing for every student, lunch, had arrived.
dialogues.text:
The bell rang, signifiying the end of 4th period. The time
of blessing for every student, lunch, had arrived.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤、飯行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Kudou, let's go get lunch."
dialogues.text: "Kudou, let's go get lunch."

dialogues.jp: 気軽な調子で工藤に声をかける。
dialogues.en: I cheerfully called out to Kudou.
dialogues.text: I cheerfully called out to Kudou.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ……うん」
dialogues.en: "Ah... okay."
dialogues.text: "Ah... okay."

dialogues.jp: 工藤は俺を見上げてこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Kudou looked up to me, blinking, then nodded her head.
dialogues.text: Kudou looked up to me, blinking, then nodded her head.

dialogues.jp: その仕草がいちいち可愛らしくてたまらない。
dialogues.en: That action was somehow exceedingly cute.
dialogues.text: That action was somehow exceedingly cute.

dialogues.jp: ……青春です。これが青春なんです。
dialogues.en: ...Just hormones. Yes, that must be it.
dialogues.text: ...Just hormones. Yes, that must be it.

dialogues.jp: そんな意味不明な事を思ってみたりなんだり。
dialogues.en: I convinced myself to stop thinking about useless things.
dialogues.text: I convinced myself to stop thinking about useless things.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんかお前達、ここ最近とみに親密度が上がっ
　てはいまいか」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, You two seem to have rather close lately."
dialogues.text: "Hmm, You two seem to have rather close lately."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達をちらりと横目で見ながら加えられ
る杉並のコメント。
dialogues.en: Suginami, glancing sideways at us, commented drily.
dialogues.text: Suginami, glancing sideways at us, commented drily.

dialogues.jp: 「ほっとけ」
dialogues.en: "Shut up."
dialogues.text: "Shut up."

dialogues.jp: 一刀両断。
dialogues.en: I ended the conversation decisively.
dialogues.text: I ended the conversation decisively.

dialogues.jp: 窓際で向かい合わせに席をとる。
dialogues.en: We sat at a table near the windows.
dialogues.text: We sat at a table near the windows.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "You know..."
dialogues.text: "You know..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
相変わらずの上品な仕草でうどんをすすりつつ
工藤が声をひそめる。
dialogues.en:
Eating her udon with her usual sense of refinement, she
started speaking.
dialogues.text:
Eating her udon with her usual sense of refinement, she
started speaking.

dialogues.jp: 俺は親子丼を｛か／掻｝っ込む箸をとめて工藤を見た。
dialogues.en:
I looked at her while stirring up my oyakodon with my
chopsticks.
dialogues.text:
I looked at her while stirring up my oyakodon with my
chopsticks.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「やっぱりみんな変に思ってるのかな……わた
　……俺達のこと」
dialogues.en: "I guess everyone's getting weird ideas... about you and I."
dialogues.text: "I guess everyone's getting weird ideas... about you and I."

dialogues.jp:
時折ちらちらと周囲を見回すのは、やはり人の
目を気にしているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
She was constantly taking glances around her during the
entire lunch period... she seems worried about it.
dialogues.text:
She was constantly taking glances around her during the
entire lunch period... she seems worried about it.

dialogues.jp: 「ん〜、｛あのバカ／杉並｝の言ってたこと気にしてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ehh, are you worried about what that idiot said?"
dialogues.text: "Ehh, are you worried about what that idiot said?"

dialogues.jp: あいつの戯言は今に始まったことじゃないのに。
dialogues.en:
It isn't the first time he said something stupid and
out-of-place.
dialogues.text:
It isn't the first time he said something stupid and
out-of-place.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「それもあるけど……なんだかこの頃人の目が
　気になって」
dialogues.en:
"Well, that and... I feel like I'm being stared at a lot
recently."
dialogues.text:
"Well, that and... I feel like I'm being stared at a lot
recently."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうか？　気のせいだろ」
dialogues.en: I reassured her, although I was uncertain myself.
dialogues.text: I reassured her, although I was uncertain myself.

dialogues.jp: とりあえず工藤を｛なだ／宥｝めるためそう言った。
dialogues.en:
Ever since I found out that Kudou was a girl, she's gotten a
lot more cuter in my eyes.
dialogues.text:
Ever since I found out that Kudou was a girl, she's gotten a
lot more cuter in my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
女の子であるという事を知ってしまっているか
らかもしれないのだが、最近、工藤がなんだか
本当にかわいく見える。
dialogues.en:
Then again, if everyone in class were to find out as well,
she'd become a lot more popular with the guys.
dialogues.text:
Then again, if everyone in class were to find out as well,
she'd become a lot more popular with the guys.

dialogues.jp:
でも、そういった事情を差し引いても近頃クラ
スの連中のみならず工藤に視線を注ぐ男どもが
増えているようなのだ。
dialogues.en: I definitely don't think that would be my imagination.
dialogues.text: I definitely don't think that would be my imagination.

dialogues.jp:
だからそれは決して俺の気のせいだけじゃない
と思う。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention although it might work out for myself better,
it would be horrible for her.
dialogues.text:
Not to mention although it might work out for myself better,
it would be horrible for her.

dialogues.jp:
俺としては喜ばしい限りだが、工藤的立場から
言えばこれは困ったことかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
After all, if she's found out, she'd have to transfer
schools.
dialogues.text:
After all, if she's found out, she'd have to transfer
schools.

dialogues.jp:
もし女であることがばれたら工藤は転校しなけ
ればならないのだ。
dialogues.en:
So to solve the problem, I have to make my own feelings
clear...
dialogues.text:
So to solve the problem, I have to make my own feelings
clear...

dialogues.jp: 工藤が転校なんて、そんなの……困る。
dialogues.en:
...As I came back to the real world, I found my oyakodon
being stirred intensely.
dialogues.text:
...As I came back to the real world, I found my oyakodon
being stirred intensely.

dialogues.jp:
せっかく、問題が解消されて、自分の気持ちが
はっきりしたっていうのに……。
dialogues.en: Kudou watched my still-revolving hand curiously.
dialogues.text: Kudou watched my still-revolving hand curiously.

dialogues.jp: （俺が彼女を守らねば！）
dialogues.en: Compared to me, Kudou was far slower in eating speed.
dialogues.text: Compared to me, Kudou was far slower in eating speed.

dialogues.jp:
気が付くと、残り少ない親子丼を箸でわしゃわ
しゃとかき混ぜていた。
dialogues.en:
At this time, when I was idly playing with the remaining
bits of food in my bowl, Kudou was still barely half-done
with her udon.
dialogues.text:
At this time, when I was idly playing with the remaining
bits of food in my bowl, Kudou was still barely half-done
with her udon.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「？？　何してるの」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I usually eat slow..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I usually eat slow..."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺に、工藤の不思議そうな視線が向けら
れる。
dialogues.en: As she apologized, I grinned, waving my chopsticks.
dialogues.text: As she apologized, I grinned, waving my chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: 「い、いやなんでもない、お前も早く食べろ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, there's no need to rush... but hurry up a bit."
dialogues.text: "Oh, there's no need to rush... but hurry up a bit."

dialogues.jp:
工藤の、食べるスピードは俺に比べてかなりゆっ
くりだ。
dialogues.en:
"I'm just taking into consideration what we were talking
about earlier."
dialogues.text:
"I'm just taking into consideration what we were talking
about earlier."

dialogues.jp:
俺がダシにまみれたごはんつぶの残りをつまん
だ時、工藤のうどんはまだ半分も減ってはいな
かった。
dialogues.en:
"You don't have to overdo it trying, to keep it up, when
you're with me."
dialogues.text:
"You don't have to overdo it trying, to keep it up, when
you're with me."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい、食べるの遅くて」
dialogues.en:
"I understand your feelings, but that's not the only thing I
have to worry about."
dialogues.text:
"I understand your feelings, but that's not the only thing I
have to worry about."

dialogues.jp:
済まなそうに言う工藤に、俺はニッと笑って箸
の先を振ってみせる。
dialogues.en: She smiled worriedly, while delicately eating her udon.
dialogues.text: She smiled worriedly, while delicately eating her udon.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、慌てないでいいから……急いで」
dialogues.en: "Yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「それって、どうすればいいの」
dialogues.en: "Well... thank you."
dialogues.text: "Well... thank you."

dialogues.jp:
困ったように笑いながらちゅるんとうどんをす
すりこむ工藤。
dialogues.en:
As she thanked me, her face showed the girlish side of her
that she had to hide.
dialogues.text:
As she thanked me, her face showed the girlish side of her
that she had to hide.

dialogues.jp: （……やっぱり、可愛いよな）
dialogues.en: "(...She really is cute.)"
dialogues.text: "(...She really is cute.)"

dialogues.jp: 改めてほれぼれとその顔を眺める。
dialogues.en: I want to keep looking at that face forever.
dialogues.text: I want to keep looking at that face forever.

dialogues.jp:
この笑顔を守るなら、なんだってできそうな気
がする。
dialogues.en: In order to protect that smile, I have to do whatever I can.
dialogues.text: In order to protect that smile, I have to do whatever I can.

dialogues.jp:
杉並が何を言おうが、俺は姫君を護るナイト役
を貫き通してやる。
dialogues.en:
No matter what Suginami might say about it, I have become
this princess's knight.
dialogues.text:
No matter what Suginami might say about it, I have become
this princess's knight.

dialogues.jp: それは俺だけに与えられた特権なのだから。
dialogues.en: That's the special right afforded to me, after all.
dialogues.text: That's the special right afforded to me, after all.

dialogues.jp: 俺は拳を握り締め、強く己に誓うのだった。
dialogues.en: I clutched my hand into a fist, and completed my vow.
dialogues.text: I clutched my hand into a fist, and completed my vow.

dialogues.jp: ◆薔薇色の日々１◆
dialogues.en: ◆Rose-Coloured Days 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆Rose-Coloured Days 1◆

dialogues.jp:
女の子だとわかったからなのか何なのか叶が
かわいくてしょうがない。
dialogues.en:
Now that I knew that she was a girl, I never looked at Kudou
Kanae the same way again.
dialogues.text:
Now that I knew that she was a girl, I never looked at Kudou
Kanae the same way again.

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺達の薔薇色の怪しい噂を耳にしても
いたが、何があってもこの俺が姫君を守って
みせるぜ。
dialogues.en:
No matter what vicious rumours might spread, whatever
happens, I'd protect my princess.
dialogues.text:
No matter what vicious rumours might spread, whatever
happens, I'd protect my princess.

dialogues.jp: ナイト気取りで拳を握りしめる俺だった。
dialogues.en: I made my vow, acting like a knight.
dialogues.text: I made my vow, acting like a knight.
